mechanism.exact: Low-byte-only addition/subtraction toward the next target's high nibble; the high byte stays at the loaded target between targets, so a downward segment wraps the low byte upward.
mechanism.variant: Signed low-byte movement carries or borrows into the pulse high byte, as SID-Wizard 1.97 Extra's PWSWEEP does (player.asm lines 2341 and 2346: dec PWHIGHO before a negative add, inc PWHIGHO on carry).
mechanism.directionRule: Direction is still chosen against the next target, compared on the 16-bit word: a target-equal high byte with a nonzero low byte keeps falling. This equals one fixed-amount PWSWEEP row per segment while interval * step < 256, which the build enforces.
mechanism.unchanged: Notes, scheduling, envelopes, delayed pitch, resonance, ending, interval reloads that set the target high nibble and clear the low byte, and the unity-gain presentation.

source.labels: SETPWID..ENDPWTB (lines 2332-2376 in the pinned 1.97 checkout); the sweep arithmetic is PWSWEEP..bcs ENDPWTB, lines 2335-2347; the raw high byte reaches the SID at line 2389
